blocks.text: Designing applications using emerging technologies begins with identifying a real-world problem and selecting the right combination of tools to solve it. For example, AI can be used for intelligent tutoring systems, IoT for smart city management, Cloud for secure data access, and Blockchain for record authentication. Students are encouraged to brainstorm ideas that directly address Pakistan's social and economic needs.

Innovation thrives when creativity meets purpose. Students can use design-thinking methods to develop user-focused, practical solutions tailored to local conditions. Projects that address issues such as water management, traffic control, or education accessibility help foster critical thinking and contribute positively to community development.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Sketch a simple app interface (on paper or digitally) that uses AI, IoT, or Cloud to solve a real-world problem.
